semantics.rust_signature: fn acos_with_context_exact_native(backend: &CpuBackend, input: &Tensor, context: &ExecutionContext<'_>) -> Result<Tensor, ElementwiseRuntimePartTwoError>
semantics.shape_rule: output shape exactly equals input shape
semantics.dtype_rule: the certified CPU overload accepts and returns f32
semantics.numeric_rule: uses IEEE f32 arccosine; values outside minus one through one yield NaN
semantics.tolerance: one micro-unit absolute tolerance on finite fixture values
semantics.cancellation_points: before validation, at bounded element intervals, during upload, and before publication
semantics.vjp_rule: output gradient is negative output_gradient divided by sqrt(one minus input squared)
semantics.jvp_rule: input tangent is negative input_tangent divided by sqrt(one minus input squared)
